title: Examining Genetic Variants Associated with FOXP1 Syndrome through Molecular Dynamics of Its DNA-Binding Domain and Self-Organizing Maps.
authors: Motta, Stefano; Perta, Nunzio; Romagnoli, Alice; Rexha, Jesmina; Buxbaum, Joseph D; De Rubeis, Silvia; Di Marino, Daniele
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学、分子对接与自组织映射，系统研究FOXP1转录因子DNA结合域致病突变对构象及DNA互作的影响，精准契合TF-DNA互作机制建模课题。
abstract: Genetic mutations in the transcription factor FOXP1 (forkhead box protein P1) cause an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder called FOXP1 syndrome. To understand the structural impact of pathogenic variants associated with FOXP1 syndrome, we investigated the conformational changes resulting from six distinct missense variants in FOXP1 by combining molecular dynamics simulations, molecular docking, and machine learning via self-organizing maps. Our results reveal different conformational landscapes mapped by the FOXP1 variants and reduced interactions with the DNA for mutations residing in helix H3 of the DNA-binding domain. These analyses offer a framework for assessing the structural impact of missense variants implicated in the FOXP1 syndrome, highlighting the importance of structural inferences in interpreting genetic variants.
abstract_zh: 转录因子FOXP1（forkhead box protein P1）的基因突变导致一种常染色体显性神经发育障碍，称为FOXP1综合征。为了理解与FOXP1综合征相关的致病性变异的结构影响，我们通过结合分子动力学模拟、分子对接以及自组织映射的机器学习方法，研究了FOXP1中六种不同错义变异引起的构象变化。我们的结果揭示了FOXP1变异所映射的不同构象景观，以及位于DNA结合域H3螺旋中的突变与DNA相互作用的减少。这些分析为评估FOXP1综合征相关错义变异的结构影响提供了一个框架，强调了结构推断在解释遗传变异中的重要性。
